title: Reciprocal Sums of Higher Figurate Numbers
description: Defines k-gonal (figurate) numbers and proves telescoping partial fractions for triangular reciprocals, with convergence of square reciprocals by p-series comparison.

meta.author: Classical
originalContributions: triangular, pentagonal, hexagonal definitions with examples

overview.historicalContext: Figurate (polygonal) numbers date to the Pythagoreans. The sum of reciprocals of triangular numbers telescopes to 2 via partial fractions. Higher figurate reciprocal sums converge by comparison with 1/n².
overview.problemStatement: Generalize Σ 1/T_n to higher figurate numbers Σ 1/P(k,n).
overview.text: k-gonal number reciprocals converge for all k >= 3 by comparison with 1/n².
overview.proofStrategy: k-gonal number reciprocals converge for all k >= 3 by comparison with 1/n².

conclusion.summary: Figurate number reciprocal sums formalized with telescoping and convergence.
conclusion.implications: Figurate number reciprocal sums formalized with telescoping and convergence.
